spans.s: अपोगण्ड a. (f. ण्डा) 1. Having a limb too many or too few; 2. infant; 3. timid, fearful; 4. not under sixteen years of age, M.viii.148.

अपोढ a. (f. ढा) 1. Removed from, (with the abl., e.g. कल्पनाया अपोढः); 2. not put on, R.xvi.73.
अपोढ a. (f. ढा) 1. Removed from, (with the abl., e.g. कल्पनाया अपोढः); 2. not put on, R.xvi.73.

अपोह n. 1. Removing, taking off; 2. removal of doubt by the exercise of the reasoning faculty; 3. negative reasoning, (op. to ऊह), ऊहापोहमिमं सरोजनयना यावद्वोधत्तेतराम् Bh.V.ii.74; 4. the exclusion of all things which do not come under the category in question. (अपोहः अतद्व्यावृत्तिः says Maheśvara on तद्वानपोहो वा शब्दार्थः K.Pr.ii.).
अपोहन n. Reasoning faculty, (the same as अपोह q.v.), मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च Bg.xv.15.
अपोह्य a. (f. ह्या) To be removed or taken away, e.g. एतैर्व्रतैरपोह्यं स्यादेनो हिंसासमुद्भवम्.
अपोह्य a. (f. ह्या) To be removed or taken away, e.g. एतैर्व्रतैरपोह्यं स्यादेनो हिंसासमुद्भवम्.

आपोशान (I) m. Name of a kind of prayer repeated before and after eating (the mantra to be repeated before eating is- अमृतोपस्तरणमसि स्वाहा and that to be repeated after eating is- अमृतापिधानमसि स्वाहा).
आपोशान (II) n. The act of making an उपस्तरण (seat) and an अपिधान (covering) for food eaten.
